## settings — values the user configures

Does: Reads the current value of each setting declared in UnitInfo.Settings, tells you when one changes, and lets the unit's own page change them.
Needs: Each setting declared in UnitInfo.Settings with a StrategyParameter factory; read it back with the same key.

Calls on `ISettings`:
- `int Int(string key)` — The value of an Int setting.
- `double Number(string key)` — The value of a Number setting.
- `bool Bool(string key)` — The value of a Bool setting.
- `string Text(string key)` — The value of a Text, Choice or Enum setting.
- `InstrumentId Instrument(string key)` — The instrument chosen for an Instrument setting.
- `void Set(string key, object value)` — Changes a setting, e.g. from a control on the unit's own page.
- `IDisposable OnChanged(Action<string> handler)` — Calls `handler` with the key whenever a setting changes; dispose to stop.

Types:
- `StrategyParameter` — Declarative description of a single tunable a strategy exposes.
  - `StrategyParameter.Int(string key, string displayName, int default, int? min = null, int? max = null, double step = 1, string? group = null, string? unit = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Number(string key, string displayName, double default, double? min = null, double? max = null, double? step = null, string? group = null, string? unit = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Bool(string key, string displayName, bool default, string? group = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Choice(string key, string displayName, string default, IReadOnlyList<string> choices, string? group = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Enum(string key, string displayName, TEnum default, IReadOnlyList<TEnum>? choices = null, string? group = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Instrument(string key, string displayName, InstrumentId default, string? group = null, string? description = null)`
  - `StrategyParameter.Text(string key, string displayName, string default = "", string? group = null, string? description = null)`

Limits: Reading a key that was never declared throws. Set converts the value to the setting's kind and clamps numbers into the declared min/max; a value that cannot be converted becomes the default. OnChanged handlers run after the current handler returns.
